text.p: Hurricane Warmings are posted from Anclote Keys to Appalachicola, Florida. Tropical Storm Warnings are extended westward west of Appalachicola to Fort Walton Beach. A Tropical Storm Warning remains in effect from the Anclote Keys to Venice.

Josephine has 70 mph winds at this time and is centered about 230 miles to the southwest of Apalachicola, Florida. Josephine is moving east northeast at 23 mph and is expected to turn to the northeast and accelerate during the next 24-36 hours with landfall southwest of Cross City in northern Florida this evening. Josephine is expected to reach Hurricane status this evening as it reaches landfall. Josephine is a threat to shipping but will also spread a large area of heavy rain and potential flooding over the eastern Gulf Coast today.

Tropical Storm Genevieve, centered about 650 miles southwest of the southern tip of Baja, is drifting very slowly northwest. Top winds are 45 mph and should remain near 45 mph through tonight as the storm moves very slowly to the northwest. This system is a moderate threat only to shipping but does not threaten any land areas at this time.
There are no further statements at this time.
